newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli shekel rises against dollar.
newsitem.headline: Israeli shekel rises against dollar.

text.p: The Israeli shekel strengthened slightly on Tuesday against the dollar following the decline of the dollar in Asia, dealers said.

"Trading was very quiet today and most of the activity was inter-bank trading. During early trading the shekel rose moderately against the dollar following the decline of the dollar in Asia," said a dealer at Israel Discount Bank.
"When the dollar recovered in Europe the shekel declined mildly, closing slightly firmer against the U.S. currency," he said.

The representative rate for the dollar was fixed at 3.2380 shekels against 3.2430 on Monday. The basket, composed of the dollar, mark, pound sterling, French franc and yen, closed at 3.6526 shekels against 3.6519 on Monday.
On the crosses the shekel traded against the yen at 2.9124 shekels per 100 yen against 2.9170 on Monday and against the mark at 2.1647 shekels against 2.1553 on Monday.
In late afternoon the dollar was trading at 3.2350 shekels.
